rules.statement: Identity of name is not essential for registration under the Land Registration Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "I quite understand the inconvenience that persons interested may experience when they wish to search the register with a view to finding out previous transactions unless the same name is carried forward, but the point is whether under the Ordinance identity of name is an essential detail. As far as I know, there is no case in which the contention on the defendant's behalf was upheld, and on principle I do not think the contention is sound."
